en.t: She deliberately extends her slender hands and now and then plucks the delicate strings.

units.source_text: 耳闻犹气绝，眼见若为怜。”是《游仙窟》中的句子。

en.t: To hear it is enough to take one's breath away; to see her is all the more moving. These are lines from Youxian Ku.

units.source_text: 此书乃唐代张文成所著，写一男子游仙境，遇一美女名十娘，善弹琴。

en.t: This book was written by Zhang Wencheng of the Tang dynasty. It tells of a man who wanders into an immortal realm and meets a beautiful woman named Shiniang, who is skilled at playing the qin.

units.source_text: 此四句乃男子描写十娘弹琴之状。

en.t: These four lines describe, from the man's point of view, how Shiniang plays the qin.
